**原假设 (错)**: check-decorative-claim.sh (immutable #1) + check-narrative.sh (#2) 缺 baseline 豁免, 每次 merge commit 扫全仓 198 处历史 jargon 被拦, 需仿 check-jargon.sh 加 is_historical_file().

**实测 (对)**:
1. check-decorative-claim.sh line 88-100 已有 KALLAX_STAGED_ONLY 模式, 只扫 git diff --cached 新增行, 历史行已 grandfathered
2. scripts/hooks/pre-commit:270 已传 KALLAX_STAGED_ONLY=1

**结论**: hook 行为正确, 0 需改 immutable. 该改的是写段习惯 (避开黑名单词).

**核心改动**:
1. CLAUDE.md §4 docs-only 批模式段: 删 'bypass check-decorative-claim 备案' 误导表述, 改 '写段禁 jargon' 正确指引
2. 新 tests/integration/immutable-staged-only.test.sh (10 case) 锚定 STAGED_ONLY 行为, 防未来再误判
3. confluence/memory/lessons/batch-8-EPIC-closure-2026-08-12.md L3 修正
